final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref GROUP BY sites.riskeval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.riskeval, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(difference) FROM step3
